With competence hubs across North America, South America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, their Industries eXcellence division specializes in the development, integration and implementation of solutions covering the end-to-end lifecycle and supply chain of all industrial products and processes. With a holistic focus on enabling the digital transformation of manufacturing and transportation organizations, their global team designs and delivers cutting-edge technology solutions that transform the way our customers think about, design, build and deliver their products and services. Learn more at www.indx.com and www.eng.it.</p></div></div><div class="de-banner__action"><a class="btn de-button btn-primary btn-sm" href="https://www.siemens.com/en-us/ecosystem/engineering-group/" target="_self" data-ste-element="conversion_main"><span class="">Discover Engineering Group</span></a></div></div></div></div></section></div><div class="sellerOfferingWhy"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><h2>Why Why Movilitas.Cloud?</h2><p>Movilitas.Cloud is the comprehensive serialization software to manage your batch traceability and serialized packaging operations. From generating unique serial numbers to automating your workflows, this software empowers you to gain full control and visibility over your serialized manufacturing.<br/><br/>Easy to use: The modern, intuitive interface requires minimal training, so you can get started quickly - no lengthy implementations.<br/><br/>Seamless integration: Integrate your packaging lines, printers, ERP/WMS, MES, and regulatory systems in one centralized software solution for end-to-end control.<br/><br/>Secure and reliable infrastructure: Hosted across three geographically split data centers, Movilitas.Cloud ensures high availability and disaster recovery for your critical serialization data.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="sellerOfferingBenefits"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><h2>Benefits</h2><ul><li>Gain full serialization visibility by consolidating all data into one platform. Track every product across its lifecycle, quickly identify issues, initiate recalls, and ensure safety. Movilitas.Cloud streamlines serialization and strengthens your supply chain.</li><li>Achieve unparalleled batch traceability: Record the complete lineage and genealogy of your batches, from raw materials to finished goods. Quickly identify the origin of quality issues and pinpoint affected products to initiate targeted recalls, protecting your brand reputation and customer safety.</li><li>Ensure regulatory compliance with ease: Stay ahead of evolving serialization regulations worldwide. This serialization software seamlessly integrates with government reporting systems, enabling you to digitally submit compliance data and exchange encrypted information with supply chain partners.</li></ul></div></div></div></div></div><div class="sellerOfferingFeatures"><section class="cards-defaultBackground" role="region" aria-labelledby="section-heading-cards-default"><div The subscription model is based on activated functionalities and the number of activated operators that can perform scanning activities.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="accordion-row-1" class="de-accordion scroll-anchor"><h3 class="de-accordion__header"><button type="button" class="de-accordion__toggle" data-ste-element="accordion-header-can-the-serialization-software-be-integrated-with-mes,-wms-and/or-erp-systems?" id="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content-accordion-row-1" tabindex="0"><span class="de-accordion__focus-target"><span class="de-accordion__title">Can the serialization software be integrated with MES, WMS and/or ERP systems?</span><span class="de-accordion__icon"><svg class="icon icon-normal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-plus"></use></svg></span></span></button></h3><div class="de-accordion__body" data-ste-element="accordion-body-can-the-serialization-software-be-integrated-with-mes,-wms-and/or-erp-systems?" hidden="" id="accordion-content-accordion-row-1" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-1" aria-hidden="true"><div class="de-accordion-group__content de-accordion-group__content-article"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><p>The provided package contains a set of APIs with a focus on integrating with packaging lines on which serialization becomes a requirement. The documentation can be found here. Integrating with WMS systems can be accomplished with the Serialized Logistics API.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="accordion-row-2" class="de-accordion scroll-anchor"><h3 class="de-accordion__header"><button type="button" class="de-accordion__toggle" data-ste-element="accordion-header-can-the-software-be-integrated-with-a-serialization-system-already-have-in-place?" id="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-2" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content-accordion-row-2" tabindex="0"><span class="de-accordion__focus-target"><span class="de-accordion__title">Can the software be integrated with a serialization system already have in place?</span><span class="de-accordion__icon"><svg class="icon icon-normal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-plus"></use></svg></span></span></button></h3><div class="de-accordion__body" data-ste-element="accordion-body-can-the-software-be-integrated-with-a-serialization-system-already-have-in-place?" hidden="" id="accordion-content-accordion-row-2" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-2" aria-hidden="true"><div class="de-accordion-group__content de-accordion-group__content-article"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><p>Yes, there are different connections available with other serialization systems, like SAP ATTP, Tracelink, LSPedia, and Arvato. Movilitas.Cloud can be used to extend the functionality of that system or make it easy to connect to Business Partners to which data needs to be exchanged.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="accordion-row-3" class="de-accordion scroll-anchor"><h3 class="de-accordion__header"><button type="button" class="de-accordion__toggle" data-ste-element="accordion-header-is-the-system-validated?" id="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-3" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content-accordion-row-3" tabindex="0"><span class="de-accordion__focus-target"><span class="de-accordion__title">Is the system validated?</span><span class="de-accordion__icon"><svg class="icon icon-normal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-plus"></use></svg></span></span></button></h3><div class="de-accordion__body" data-ste-element="accordion-body-is-the-system-validated?" hidden="" id="accordion-content-accordion-row-3" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-3" aria-hidden="true"><div class="de-accordion-group__content de-accordion-group__content-article"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><p>The system is also used in Life Science, and for that reason, we need to keep the software in a validated state. All quality documentation is kept up-to-date and all required SOPs and SDLC are in place.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="accordion-row-4" class="de-accordion scroll-anchor"><h3 class="de-accordion__header"><button type="button" class="de-accordion__toggle" data-ste-element="accordion-header-can-i-also-use-the-system-standalone?" id="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-4" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content-accordion-row-4" tabindex="0"><span class="de-accordion__focus-target"><span class="de-accordion__title">Can I also use the system standalone?</span><span class="de-accordion__icon"><svg class="icon icon-normal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-plus"></use></svg></span></span></button></h3><div class="de-accordion__body" data-ste-element="accordion-body-can-i-also-use-the-system-standalone?" hidden="" id="accordion-content-accordion-row-4" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-toggle-accordion-row-4" aria-hidden="true"><div class="de-accordion-group__content de-accordion-group__content-article"><div class="columnArticleClass two-layout-bg-white" id="oneColumnArticleTheme"><div class="text-start container multitextblock "><div class="row justify-content-left"><div class="col col-md-8"><p>The system can be used stand-alone.
